sections.Profile:
Swing-Along , released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1963, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Singing, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
